note: Everything needed to reproduce the jar and the Java runtime that ship beside the core. `make runtime` refuses to package either one if its sha256 does not match. The jar comes from the same FreeJ2ME-Plus commit as the core; the build checks that against core/core.lock.json.

container.note: The same toolchain image as the core, run as linux/arm64 so the aarch64 JDKs can execute: jlink, and the CDS dump, which runs the target java binary. `digest` is the linux/arm64 manifest inside the multi-arch index the core pins (`index_digest`). Pinning the platform manifest, not the index, matters on Docker's classic image store, where pulling the index's arm64 variant after the core has pulled its amd64 variant fails with "cannot overwrite digest". The image contributes only a glibc userland and Python for the jar normalizer; the Java toolchain comes from the archives below. On an x86_64 host this needs QEMU binfmt (docker/setup-qemu-action in CI).

inputs.name: zulu-jdk8
inputs.role: Compiles the jar. Upstream build.xml targets Java 1.5 against ${java.home}/lib/rt.jar, which only a JDK 8 has; upstream CI uses JDK 8 too.

inputs.name: temurin-jdk17
inputs.role: Source of the shipped runtime: its jmods are linked by its own jlink.
inputs.release_source_note: The SOURCE line of the JDK's own release file. The build refuses a JDK whose release file says otherwise, which ties the shipped runtime to runtime_source below.

runtime_source.name: temurin-jdk17-sources
runtime_source.role: GPL corresponding source for the shipped runtime. Not used by the build; make dist-source verifies it and publishes it beside the pak.
runtime_source.note: Adoptium publishes this tarball with the binaries it was built into. Its release metadata names the same jdk17u commit, scm ref and temurin-build commit as the aarch64 JDK above, and the JDK's release file names the same commit (SOURCE=.:git:79597447bd94). The sha256 matches Adoptium's published .sha256.txt.

jar.note: Ant writes entries in directory-scan order with build-time timestamps. scripts/normalize-jar.py rewrites the jar inside the pinned image with sorted entries, fixed timestamps and the image's zlib, so the bytes depend only on the inputs.

runtime.modules_note: jdeps on the jar reports java.base and java.desktop; jlink adds java.desktop's requirements (java.datatransfer, java.prefs, java.xml). jdk.charsets is not visible to jdeps: FreeJ2ME names Shift_JIS, EUC_KR and Big5 by string, and the core's encoding option passes -Dfile.encoding=Shift_JIS or EUC_KR. Without it those lookups throw.
runtime.jlink_options_note: --strip-debug would also strip native symbols, which needs objcopy and gains nothing: the JDK's native libraries carry no debug sections beyond a debuglink. --compress=2 (zip) was measured on the MLP1 on 2026-10-17 against --compress=0, both with CDS, using the then-shipped Zulu build of the same OpenJDK version: first paint was no slower in any paired run (cold 8.44 s vs 8.54 s, warm 5.44/5.54 s vs 5.64/5.60 s), because the CDS archive already covers the startup classes, and the image is about 25 MB smaller on the card.
runtime.cds: lib/server/classes.jsa, dumped with -Xshare:dump -Xmx128M -Xms128M (the heap size OpenJDK's own build uses) from jlink's default class list. jlink --generate-cds-archive would also write classes_nocoops.jsa, which only applies to heaps over 32 GB.
runtime.cds_note: JDK 17 does not write this archive byte-for-byte reproducibly here: two dumps of the same tree differ in about 20 bytes (header CRCs, one header word, a few archived-heap bytes), and -Xint makes it worse. It is a derived cache of classes already in lib/modules, so tree_sha256 leaves it out and the build only requires that it exists. The JVM validates it at startup (JVM build and modules size) and ignores it, with a warning on stderr, if it does not match.
runtime.tree_sha256_note: scripts/tree-hash.py: for each regular file in byte order of its relative path, rel || 0x00 || mode (4 octal digits) || 0x00 || uint64_be(size) || bytes. Symlinks are refused; the build replaces jlink's legal-notice symlinks with copies so the tree is FAT32-safe.
runtime.size_note: 67.7 MB on disk with the CDS archive, recorded from two FORCE=1 rebuilds that agree (2026-10-18). The Zulu build of the same version and options was 67.3 MB.
